findings.message: Do not remove the safety ground collider merely because Terrain3D was asked to rebuild; retain it until live terrain ray contacts prove the active spawn and bridge bank are backed by Terrain3D collision.
Pure bank-height math is insufficient. Add extension-gated integration coverage for imported terrain, dynamic collision and spawn/bank ray contact.
Build the HUD and inspect actual slot children/icons/active border; retain a clean, unobstructed capture.
Desktop-window-obscured screenshots cannot close the visual gate. The first vista remains flat lawn plus a cyan river strip; captured visual evidence must be unobstructed and show traversal.
